# What is Creative Shadow Realm?
Creative Shadow Realm is a Minecraft server network with multiple servers providing different gameplay experiences.

# Why join?
Creative Shadow Realm provides multiple game modes on different servers to suit any player. Additionally, due to the very small size of the server anybody can have a big influence on the server and its future. Any player who joins will be welcomed and have friendly interactions. The server is also intended for fun events and content creation where you can either make your own content or take part in a video or livestream.

# On which versions can players join?
Creative Shadow Realm supports Java 1.14+ and Bedrock clients. That basically means that players who play on any Java version that's 1.14 or newer or Bedrock can join. For modded servers you will need to be on a specific Java version and have specific mods installed.
